sources.title: HYREC-2: a highly accurate sub-millisecond recombination code
sources.reuse: Reuse effective excited-state algebra and explicit Sobolev rate mapping under matched radiation assumptions.
sources.boundary: SWIFT correction Delta(Tr, parameters) is calibrated using isotropic FULL histories; it is not a Bianchi calibration. Net ground-transition rates can depend on time history.

hydrogen.c 490–543: EMLA interface and dx/dln a conversion

sources.title: Time-dependent corrections to the Ly-alpha escape probability during cosmological hydrogen recombination
sources.reuse: Source formula for local complete-redistribution Sobolev escape and explicit limitations.
sources.boundary: PDF typesetting metadata includes 2018; that does not change the 2008 submission/2009 v2 and journal identity. Thick optical depth alone does not bound neglected time-dependent transfer.

sources.title: Lyman-alpha transfer in primordial hydrogen recombination
locations: Time-dependent Ly-alpha transport equation and resonant scattering formulation
sources.reuse: Define physical scope: profile equality, complete redistribution, isolated line, quasi-stationarity.
sources.boundary: A mean-escape tensor identity does not remove frequency diffusion, recoil, thermodynamic profile differences or history dependence.

sources.title: CosmoRec author distribution page
sources.reuse: Authoritative process inventory and effective-multilevel architecture; existing code/reference donor rather than rerun.
sources.boundary: Author-listed FLRW precision is not measured Bianchi accuracy; no new tarball downloaded or run. Atomic/radiation source binding still required.

sources.title: RECFAST author distribution page and Fortran source
sources.reuse: Modified three-level H/He model, separately evolved matter temperature and existing project FLRW reference; source docs fix xHe normalization and SI conventions.
sources.boundary: Fudge functions are near-standard-cosmology calibrations; historic C distribution is marked out of date and has separate Numerical Recipes dependency.
sources.license_status: Fortran source header grants use/copy/modify/distribute subject to preservation of copyright and disclaimer.
sources.identity_level: Retrieved textual representation; raw-byte source hash not measured.

sources.title: Analytical and fitting formulae for solutions to Lyman-alpha radiative transfer equations: the effects of geometry, recoil, and velocity gradients
sources.reuse: Boundary-aware comparison: finite clouds, steady transfer, geometry/recoil/velocity-gradient approximations.
sources.boundary: Finite slab/cylinder/sphere cloud with boundary escape, predominantly T=10 K simulations; not directly usable as a primordial cosmological recombination correction.

sources.boundary: Spatial baryon clumping with PMF-induced MHD and nonlocal Ly-alpha transfer; distinct additional physics and outside the requested one-year freshness interval.
